page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.45-180 is an ARM-based compute instance powered by the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor architecture. The platform features 90 dedicated physical cores mapped directly to 90 vCPUs with a single thread per core, eliminating performance interference associated with simultaneous multithreading. System memory capacity is 180.0 GB, yielding a constant memory-to-core allocation of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

Hardware accelerator components such as discrete GPUs are not present on this instance, and it does not include bundled local storage drives. Persistent storage must be provided via network-attached volumes. Network provisioning includes one complimentary public IPv4 address for external routing.

With a 1:2 core-to-memory ratio and dedicated core tenancy, the configuration delivers dense multi-core processing capacity without the resource sharing inherent to hyperthreaded platforms. The instance profile is aligned with CPU-bound parallel workloads, distributed build pipelines, containerized microservices, and general scale-out arm64 infrastructure.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.45-180 is an arm64 compute-oriented instance powered by an Ampere AmpereOne-M processor. The platform provisions 90 dedicated physical cores across 90 vCPUs with a single execution thread per core, eliminating simultaneous multithreading contention. Accompanying the processor is 180.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 core-to-memory allocation of 2.0 GB per core. The server does not incorporate local storage drives or discrete GPU accelerators, utilizing remote block storage for persistence. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. Given its high core density and predictable dedicated execution resources, this instance profile is suited for compute-heavy parallel workloads, batch data processing, continuous integration build pipelines, and container orchestration clusters operating on the 64-bit ARM architecture.
